title: gdpr.section.erased
description: Receipt for one erasure, echoing the correlation_id of the gdpr.erasure.requested (or deprecated user.deleted) event that asked. This module sends {owner: "video", subject_type: "account", subject_key, correlation_id, receipt_id, counts: {rooms, participations, presence_spans}} in the same transaction as the erasure, so a rollback takes the receipt with it. presence_spans counts rows PSEUDONYMIZED, not removed: the meter is the product's record and keeps its arithmetic, the person's id in it does not. The shape below is the ACTION's contract, not this emitter's subset: comm registers one schema per action name across the whole process, so it must keep accepting the older {user_id, service} spelling other owners still send (stapel-gdpr 0.5.0 accepts both).
